none: PAS CAM-E34060: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N CONSTA-NS PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans, 337-350. Mint is Trier, 348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N CONSTA-NS PF AVG. Reverse shows Phoenix on rocks right. Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP REPARATIO. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TRP. Condition is very fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.41g, diameter is 17.90mm.…
